answers.text: Kilowatts (kW) measure power, while kilowatt-hours (kWh) measure energy. Power is the rate at which energy is consumed or produced, measured in watts or kilowatts. Energy is the amount of power used over a period of time, measured in watt-hours or kilowatt-hours. kW and kWh are not interchangeable because energy is power multiplied by time. [1]

sources.title: Power and energy: kW versus kWh
sources.passage: Power expresses the rate at which energy is consumed or produced. It is measured in watts (W) or kilowatts (kW): one kilowatt equals one thousand watts. Energy consumed over an interval can be expressed in watt-hours (Wh) or kilowatt-hours (kWh).

sources.title: Power and energy: kW versus kWh
sources.passage: If power remains constant, energy is power multiplied by time. For example, a 100 W appliance running for three hours consumes 300 Wh, or 0.3 kWh. This calculated example illustrates why kW and kWh are not interchangeable.

answers.text: GPS calculates its position by receiving signals from satellites, which are used to estimate distances and correct the receiver's clock. [1]

sources.title: GPS: position from satellites
sources.passage: A GPS receiver calculates its position from radio signals sent by satellites. The time taken by each signal helps estimate the distance to the satellite. Combining several signals provides the receiver position and corrects its clock.

sources.title: Why GPS accuracy changes
sources.passage: GPS position accuracy depends on satellite geometry, obstacles blocking signals, atmospheric conditions, and receiver characteristics. The accuracy of the transmitted signal does not guarantee the same accuracy on a phone.

sources.title: GPS: position from satellites
sources.passage: Receiving satellite signals is different from downloading an online map. A receiver can therefore calculate coordinates without a data connection. To show those coordinates on a map, the application must also have the map available. This is an educational explanation, not a test of any particular application.
